text.text_excerpt: One of my favorite structures in City Park, the Peristyle was originally used for weekend dances and live music way back before there was electricity, or recorded music, for that matter. These days it is used as a rent-able party space, a wedding hall, a photo backdrop and a place for the symphony to play to the crowds in the Great Lawn the week before Jazz Fest each spring. I've see yoga & exercise classes happening there, although not sanctioned by the park, it is a great spot to stretch out and enjoy the breeze. I love the peristyle! Not only is it probably one of the most well known landmarks at City Park, but there is always something going on. Most recently, the peristyle hosted "Swingin' in the Oaks", which featured an orchestra playing all kinds of classic songs. The thing that I like most about the peristyle is the wide open space where you can just go and sit and relax on a nice day. One of my favorite things to do is get an iced coffee from Morning Call, and sit on the steps next to the lion statues and just relax and watch the goings on in the rest of the park.
